The enemies that appear on the sub-field during Live Showdown are as follows: Phase 1: Aggressive Reading Material * 3, each one filling 33.3% of the durability gauge. The leftmost Aggressive Reading Material has its first action advanced by 70%, while the others have their first actions advanced by 30%. Phase 2: Aggressive Reading Material , Live Stream Assistant , Aggressive Reading Material The Aggressive Reading Materials have fill 30% of the durability gauge (15% each), while the Live Stream Assistant fills the remaining 70%. The Live Stream Assistant has its first action advanced by 70%, while the Aggressive Reading Material have their first actions advanced by 30%. When fought in Currency Wars, an additional Phase is added between its two existing ones, which uses her original Phase 2 moveset but contains only a Live Stream Assistant on the sub-field. Live Showdown (General Mechanics) [ ] The character selected for Live Showdown will immediately take action. This does not apply to their summons. Attacking Output Port 1 and Output Port 2 will immediately increase "Ally Popularity" and "Enemy Popularity", respectively. They will immeediately take action, during which they'll increase the corresponding " Ally Gratuity Ally Gratuity All-Type RES PEN Boost. " or " Enemy Gratuity Enemy Gratuity Increases DMG dealt. " to match. "Ally Gratuity" grants the chracters in the sub-field 5% All-Type RES PEN per stack, while "Enemy Gratuity" grants the enemies in the sub-field a 10% DMG Boost per stack. Both have a maximum of 4 stacks. When Live Showdown begins, Output Port 1 and Output Port 2 are cleansed of any debuffs, and their Toughness is reset to their maximum values. If @SparxiConOfficial is Weakness Broken when Live Showdown ends, she will immediately recover from it. During Phase 1, if the characters going into the sub-field are Departed Departed Targets in the Departed state cannot be designated as ability targets and will not appear in the Action Order. , Commence Chat Bombing! will be casted on a random character instead. Possible Bullet Comment penalties inflicted by Bullet Comments Ready! include: Entanglement, -10% SPD (2 Turns), -10% DMG dealt (2 Turns), -10% DEF (2 Turns), and -10% ATK (2 Turns)

gameplayNotes: When the battle starts, advances the action of Alloy Mechatron: King Pom-Pom by 50%. Upon entering Phase 2, Alloy Mechatron: King Pom-Pom will immediately use High-Temp Sterilization Mode . “Venue Protocol Enforcer” has an Action Value of 64, with its first action placed at 35 AV. When it takes action, summons two "Alloy Pommy" , as well as an ally "Alloy Pommy" during its first action. Ally "Alloy Pommy" acts at 70 AV, with its first action advanced by 100%. Ally "Alloy Pommy" abilities: Ability Type Tag Toughness Reduction Effect Housecleaning Basic ATK Single Target 10 Deals Quantum DMG ( 400% ATK ) to one designated enemy and gains Punchline ( 5 ). Dirt Water Slinging Skill Impair 20 Consumes 20 point(s) of Charge, dealing Quantum DMG ( 300% ATK ) to one designated enemy target and True DMG equal to a certain percentage of the target's Max HP ( 1.5% Max HP ), and removes 1 stack of the "Lasting Antibac" effect from the target. Extremeflash Charge Talent N/A N/A Each time ally targets gain 1 Punchline, this unit accumulates 1 Charge Value point. Upon reaching 20 Charge Value points, immediately gains an extra turn and gains access to Enhanced Basic ATK ( Dirt Water Slinging ). When encountered in Currency Wars, multiple changes are applied: "Steam Wash" increases the boss's DMG dealt by 20% (down from 30%). "Lasting Antibac" reduces the boss's DMG taken by 15%/25% per stack in Phase 1/2 (down from 30%/45% per stack in Phase 1/2). The Punchline granted from Saturation Cleaning! is reduced from 5 to 4. When fought in the Third Plane, an additional Phase is added between the two existing ones. This phase uses its original Phase 2 moveset, but does not immediately use High-Temp Sterilization Mode and lacks the Potent Foam Soap ability. When encountered in Pure Fiction , multiple changes are applied: This boss only has one phase, which uses its phase 2 moveset. “Venue Protocol Enforcer” is not added to the Action Order, but Ally "Alloy Pommy" immediately joins the battle when Alloy Mechatron: King Pom-Pom spawns. Alloy Mechatron: King Pom-Pom will not immediately use High-Temp Sterilization Mode , unlike its original second phase. Additionally, the DMG reduction provided by "Lasting Antibac" is 30% per stack , equivalent to the boss's original first phase. The True DMG dealt by the "Shiny" effect of "Work Is Bliss!" is reduced from 2% Target Max HP to 1% Target Max HP .

(Memosprites do not count towards the total amount of characters.) Story Battles [ ] In Exploratory Excursion The Final Flame-Chase Journey , at the start of Phase 3, it will immediately set its HP to Infinite and set "Amphorean Hatred" to 100%, but will use Resist and Destroy instead of Ashes of All Begets Genesis . During this time, the team's maximum Skill Points are reduced to 0, and their Ultimates and the battle's Assist Skills are disabled and cannot be used. The battle ends immediately upon the use of Immolate the Heavens, Abandon the World . In Exploratory Excursion The Headless Archsmith, Flame of Destruction , Anti-Creator, Hatred Inundate starts at Phase 3, and Cyrene(Assist) immediately take action and use Epics, As We've Written at the start of the battle, reducing its HP from Infinite to 90000x health bar layers. Additionally, the max "Amphorean Hatred" value is reduced to 99%, preventing the use of Ashes of All Begets Genesis . When Anti-Creator, Hatred Inundate reaches 50000x health bar layers, it will immediately take action and attempt to use The Spirit's Prison Shall Burn . However, Cyrene (Player)'s Memosprite Demiurge will immediately take action and use Minuet of Blooms and Plumes , cancelling the attack. When Anti-Creator, Hatred Inundate reaches 5000x health bar layers, Cyrene(Assist) immediately take action and use Epics, As We've Written , which deals 1+6+28+134+496+8128+108642+2003432+4000001+23570000+33550337 (Total 63241205) fixed True DMG to Anti-Creator, Hatred Inundate and reduces its HP to 1x health bar layer, before ending the battle. Other [ ] Anti-Creator, Hatred Inundate 's Max HP increases by 25% in Phase 2, and 5000% in Phase 3 [ verification needed ] , the latter phase represented by a 99999-layer health bar. All allies will gain the Chronicled "Love" effect during Phase 3 to compensate for the increased HP. When fought during the King in Check stage of Anomaly Arbitration: Return of the Legion , Anti-Creator, Hatred Inundate 's Phase 3 HP is equal to its Phase 1 HP, and Chronicled "Love" is not granted. At the start of Phase 3, Anti-Creator, Hatred Inundate will immediately take action and use Resist and Destroy . Each stack of "Morale" increases the Black Tide Champion's DMG dealt by 20%. Depleting the Duel's progress bar to 0 requires the Duel target to deplete 30% of the Black Tide Champion's HP [ verification needed ] . If the Black Tide's Champion is forced into a Weakness Broken state while in the Duel state, it is automatically dispelled and is considered a loss for the Black Tide Champion. If the targeted character is defeated while the Black Tide Champion has selected them in the Duel state, it is considered a win for the Black Tide Champion and it will automatically use "Spirit Breaker" even if the character is revived through other means.

gameplayNotes: From Apocalyptic Shadow: Gambling Primate to Apocalyptic Shadow: Primate Knight , the Toughness of Blaznana Monkey Trick was increased from 130 to 160 in Stage 4. In Apocalyptic Shadow: Vanguard Knight , their Toughness in Stage 4 was further increased to 190 . When a phase of Blaznana Monkey Trick starts, resets all enemies' Action Value , then adjusts their Action Value: The Action of Banacademic Office's Assistanana (right) is Advanced Forward by 100% . The Action of Banacademic Office's Dreamweaver BananAdvisor is Advanced Forward by 50% . The Action of Banacademic Office's Fortune BananAdvisor is Delayed by 100% . The Action of Banacademic Office's Charmony BananAdvisor is Delayed by 50% . Tally Loss (Stage 3+): At the beginning of every turn, enemy units in "Classroom Channel" will lose 1 in the Switch Tally. When a Banacademic Office member is Weakness Broken via accumulating the Switch Tally or breaking the Weakness of Blaznana Monkey Trick, triggers the Imaginary Weakness Break effect instead. "End-of-Semester Dinner" has the same base SPD as Blaznana Monkey Trick. SPD Boost (Stage 4): Increases SPD for "End-of-Semester Dinner" by 10 . When "End-of-Semester Dinner" is added on the Action Order for the first time, advances its action by 25% .

gameplayNotes: When Summon the Pack takes action, one summoned Wolftrooper has their action advanced forward by 85% (Phase 1 & 2), and the other summoned Wolftrooper has their action advanced forward by 77% (Phase 2). Summon the Pack acts at a fixed 105 SPD, and it immediately takes action when Borisin Warhead: Hoolay spawns. When Hoolay enters the Moon Rage state, its Action Value will be reset to its base value. When Hoolay enters the Moon Rage state, he will immediately take action. While Hoolay is in the Moon Rage state, the Lupine Lord's Majesty buff enhances Sableclaw Wolftroopers ' and Eclipse Wolftroopers ' Moon Rage state and allows the Wolftroopers to take an extra action every turn. When Hoolay is Weakness Broken due to the Toughness Reduction effect of Moonhowl Lupus , triggers the Lightning Weakness Break effect. When fought in Pure Fiction , several changes are applied: This boss has only one phase, which uses its Phase 2 moveset. Summon the Pack is no longer added on the Action Order. Barrenness of Earth Gouged delays all other targets by 30% (Up from 20% to characters) and deals 50% ATK Lightning DMG to them (down from 100000% ATK to other enemies).

gameplayNotes: The Canvas Peacock's Weakness(es) are determined by the type of elemental attack(s) used on it while in its Colorless state. These Weaknesses are maintained alongside the Color state and corresponding RES decrease until it either recovers from Weakness Break or uses Palette Meltdown to consume all remaining Paint. Each attack that hits the Canvas Peacock applies one stack of Paint, regardless of the instances of DMG it takes from it, while attacks that deal Elation DMG apply two additional stacks of Paint (for a total of 3 stacks): Ultramarine (Quantum) Pure Crimson (Fire) Pale Yellow (Imaginary) Jade Green (Wind) Indigo (Ice) Wisteria Purple (Lightning) Unbleached Silk (Physical) Punchline gained upon entering the Color state is 5 times the Paint that was applied the most. Paint is consumed in a first in, first out order. Once the Color state is entered, the Canvas Peacock will automatically implant weakness(es) based on the Paint stacks it possesses (if not already implanted), gain an Extra Action and begins to use Sweeping Hues , Dancing Splendor and Palette Meltdown . Each of these attacks consumes Paint. If the Canvas Peacock is Weakness Broken while in its Color state, it will consume all remaining Paint stacks and take DMG equal to 3% of its Max HP per stack lost this way.

gameplayNotes: During "Breeding Frenzy" , Cyclonic Swarm Mother 's next action is always placed right after "Incubation" , which shares its SPD but is placed at 150% of its base Action Value . Each instance of "Breeding Frenzy" creates 4 eggs behind the Cyclonic Swarm Mother , each representing a single Mirage Fizzle Kid that can be spawned by the ability. When Cyclonic Swarm Mother takes its turn during "Breeding Frenzy" (either by triggering "Respite By The Waters" or by directly advancing it through an ability such as Calamity: Soulscorch Edict ), it loses 5% of its Max HP and attempts to prematurely spawn 2 of its Mirage Fizzle Kids , who enter the battle with a 75% action advance, 50% of their Max HP, and enter the "Weakling" state. Premature summons will also delay "Incubation" by 10% . Weakness Breaking the Cyclonic Swarm Mother during "Breeding Frenzy" will cause a similar effect, but attempt to prematurely summon all remaining Mirage Fizzle Kids instead of just 2. When "Incubation" takes action, attempts to spawn any remaining Mirage Fizzle Kids , who enter the battle with no action advance, 100% of their Max HP, and a Barrier . When "Incubation" takes action, Cyclonic Swarm Mother will restore their Toughness and enter the "Fetal Movement of the Ocean" state. During the "Fetal Movement of the Ocean" state, Cyclonic Swarm Mother will not take an extra action during its turn.

gameplayNotes: First Genius, Entelechy, Zandar starts the battle in "Evolution Mode" (Form 1). When re-entering "Evolution Mode," removes any Black Tide Creatures summoned by "Disputation Mode" (Form 2). When "Mythical Life Evolution System" takes action, two Furiae Warrior are summoned onto the field, increasing the count of "To Logos" by 2. When "Evolution Mode" begins, "Mythical Life Evolution System" is placed on the Action Order at 42 Action Value . Afterwards, it will act a second time at 58 AV, for a maximum "Evolution Mode" duration of 100 AV. When entering "Disputation Mode," all Furiae Warriors are removed and replaced with three Tide-Eroded Blades and one Black Tide's Corroded Axe . All enemies that spawn durng Disputation Mode will immediately lose 40% of their Max HP. "CALL _DESTRUCTION_THEOREM" acts at 210 SPD. Every time "Disputation Mode" begins, its first action is advanced by 50%. If the Ultimate provivded by "Antinomy" is not used during the affected character's turn, their Energy is reset to its value prior to being affected by it. Characters who do not use the Energy system, such as Castorice , Phainon , and Cyrene , will retain their activated Ultimate after Antinomy wears off. When fought in Pure Fiction , the naturally-respawning enemies count towards the tallies of Mythos Axiom and Logos ALG . To compensate, the following changes are applied: SET Proof_Method=Black_Tide will be casted after 6 total friendly units and enemy memosprites have been created (up from 4). "Mythical Life Evolution System" is no longer added on the Action Order.

gameplayNotes: Wolftroopers will continuously spawn, and up to 2 Wolftroopers can exist on the field at a time. Killing a Wolftrooper will add one stack of Irate to Hoolay. Eclipse Wolftroopers summoned by this boss have Weaknesses, while Sableclaw Wolftroopers summoned by this boss have Weaknesses. When Hoolay enters the "Lunar Devourer" state, he will immediately take action and use "Going Solo." During the solo, Hoolay's starting Action Value is always set to 40 ; after Hoolay's action, the selected character will then immediately take action, and the summon will take action immediately after their character. After the selected character or their summon attacks during the solo, they will additionally reduce 1.667 Toughness per "Blood Surge" stack. When "Irate" reduces to 0, Hoolay will use "Lupine Chase Calls Bloody Gleam." If the character selected for "Going Solo" causes a Weakness Break on Hoolay during the standoff, it will automatically end. Better Safe Than Sorry : When Hoolay uses "Barrenness of Earth Gouged," all other Wolftroopers will be eliminated. Apex Predator (Stage 3+): After Hoolay enters Phase II, it gains extra action per turn during "Going Solo." Till Death (Stage 4): After Hoolay enters "Going Solo," reduces its DMG taken by an additional 15% .

gameplayNotes: Faces [ ] During Phase 1, Lord of Saṃvartasthāyi, Asat Pramad will exclusively use his "Formation" face, described on this page. During Phase 2, Lord of Saṃvartasthāyi, Asat Pramad will alternate between his "Formation" and "Existence faces after he takes action. Contrary to the description, Asat Pramad will not use Meme Setup or Meme Carnival when using his "Existence" face, and will not use Gambit of Converging Fates while using his "Formation" face. When Phase 3 starts, Asat Pramad’s faces (listed from left to right) have the following initial action advances: "Existence" : 50% "Decay" : 100% "Formation" : 0% During Phase 3, "Formation" acts at a base SPD of 140 , while "Existence" acts at a base SPD of 120 . "Formation" [ ] While an ally has Meme'd , their Ultimate is replaced with a special action that prematurely detonates 1 of their stacks. However, their Ultimates can still be charged normally during this period. The 4 stacks of Meme'd generated by Meme Setup will be evenly distributed between all targetable ally characters. If there are 3 targets on the field, only one character will receive 2 stacks. Meme'd is automatically dispelled if Lord of Saṃvartasthāyi, Asat Pramad is Weakness Broken or changes phase. Other [ ] "Take the Stage" acts at a Base SPD of 115 , and its first action is advanced by 100% . It takes immediate action when Lord of Saṃvartasthāyi, Asat Pramad changes phase. "The Game is On" acts at a Base SPD of 95 . Its SPD is increased by 35% in Phase 3. When entering Phase 2, Lord of Saṃvartasthāyi, Asat Pramad: "Existence" will immediately use Gambit of Converging Fates , before switching faces. During Phase 3, the total Max HP of all 3 faces is 165% of the original. [ verification needed ]

gameplayNotes: Lordly Trashcans are listed along with Treasures and Warp Trotters in map exploration progress. To obtain the reward for a Lordly Trashcan, the player must interact with the idle Trashcan and respond to its questions. If the player answers the questions correctly, the rewards will be given directly without having to enter battle. If the player answers incorrectly, the Lordly Trashcan will attempt to ambush the player. It is possible to dodge a Lordly Trashcan's ambush attempt, though it is not possible to engage in battle without being ambushed. Attempting to attack a Lordly Trashcan will only stun it briefly, without entering battle. If the player dodges the Lordly Trashcan's attack and leaves its detection radius, the Lordly Trashcan will return to its idle state and will become interactable again. This allows the player to restart the dialogue from the beginning. When fighting a Lordly Trashcan, the player must either cause a Weakness Break or deplete its health like a normal enemy. The latter option is nearly impossible outside of Divergent/Simulated Universe, since this would require three combat types to avoid accidentally breaking its Toughness bar, and it would likely have enough ATK to instantly defeat anyone it attacks. Once their Toughness depletes, Lordly Trashcans will immediately enter a follow-up action, bowing and leaving the battle.

For each failure, this chance increases by 33% . [ verification needed ] If "Grudge Ablaze" is successfully dispelled via "Extinguish Flames", the affected character is healed by 30% of their Max HP. Grand Vista: Devourer Murata attempts to inflict "Grudge Ablaze" on 2 random targets [ verification needed ] . When fought in the King in Check stage of Anomaly Arbitration: Enwreathed By the World , Murata Graphia, Founding Artist 's SPD increases by 15 , but she loses 7% Max HP when God-Devourer Offspring are defeated (up from 2%). When fought during the Third Plane in Currency Wars, an additional Phase is added between the two existing ones. This phase uses her Phase 1 moveset, but replaces the ability Infernal Gory Blockprint with Infernal Gory Blockprint: Finest Ink .

gameplayNotes: During Phase 1: The Action of Opportunistic Provocateur is Advanced Forward by 100% when the battle starts. The Action of Abundance Lotus is Delayed by 100% when summoned. During Phase 2: The Actions of all Abundance Lotus and Destruction Lotus are Delayed by 100% when summoned. The Lock-On target of Eternal Condemnation (lotuses from left to right in the player's viewpoint) corresponds to the character's position. Flower By Another Name : When a new Lotus is summoned, Opportunistic Provocateur will enter the Toughness Protection state. Defeating any summon will dispel her Toughness Protection and deal 55 Toughness Reduction to her. Defeating an Abundance Lotus grants all allies the DMG Boost buff ( 20% Per Stack ), while defeating a Destruction Lotus grants all allies the Break Effect Increase buff ( 25% Per Stack ). The two buffs are mutually exclusive with each other. When allies are granted one buff, they will be unable to obtain the other buff for the rest of the battle. During Phase 1, Opportunistic Provocateur will switch between Forms once every 3 turns. Withered Tree's Revival (Stage 3+): When Opportunistic Provocateur changes form, all summons are healed for 25% of their Max HP. Hollowflower Blaze (Stage 4+): During Phase 2, all summons gain 20% increased Max HP.

gameplayNotes: When the battle starts, advances the action of Paramount Bliss Inverted: Illwish Archlotus by 50%. Contrary to the description, "Happiness" stacks are not lost when an Illwish Lotus is summoned. An ally that's already inflicted with "Happiness Puppet" cannot be reafflicted with "Happiness" until it wears off. When an ally with "Happiness" takes their turn, attempts to summon 2 Illwish Lotus . One has its first action advanced by 75%, while the other will be advanced by 25%. Illwish Spray cannot target Memosprites, and their memotrainer's Happiness is not reduced when a Memosprite attacks or defeats an enemy. During the battle against Paramount Bliss Inverted: Illwish Archlotus in Trailblaze Mission Happiness, or a Fatal Ailment in the chapter So Laughed the Masses , Inverted Severance provides the beneficiary with a 200% CRIT DMG boost (up from 80%), but Siphon Woe heals the boss for 3% of its Max HP per target affected (up from 0.5%). When fought during the Third Plane in Currency Wars, this enemy has an additional phase between its first and second, during which it uses its second phase moveset with Illwish Spray targeting three allies.

gameplayNotes: During the first phase, Shadow of "Feixiao" is fought alone. Whenever Shadow of "Feixiao" uses Heaven's Binds , the resulting additional actions are independent actions called Surging Gale they are not Extra Actions that Echo of War enemies usually have. Causing a Weakness Break on Shadow of "Feixiao" will remove the additional actions. If the targeted part(s) during phase 2 and 3 enhanced by Beastbond Strike or Sweep the Heavens, Swallow the Earth are Weakness Broken , the whole party is given an Advance Forward. If they were already Weakness Broken when the ability is used, their Toughness is restored to full. During phase 3, whenever Shadow of "Feixiao" activates Sweep the Heavens, Swallow the Earth , it will be removed as a target until the attack concludes.

gameplayNotes: Silver Knight of Virtuous Gallantry's Toughness changes depending on the Apocalyptic Shadow difficulty: Difficulty 01: 140 Difficulty 02: 180 Difficulty 03: 220 Difficulty 04 ( Primate Knight onwards): 300 When Silver Knight of Virtuous Gallantry uses Lance's Summon , Shield's Summon , or Honored Multitudes , "Soulfreed" is applied to one of the summoned statues. Turn Back the Tide (Stage 3+): When Silver Knight of Virtuous Gallantry applies "Soulfreed" during Phase 2, he will do so to all four statues instead of just one. Silver Knight of Virtuous Gallantry can swap between three Combat Stance Combat Stance The Silver Knight of Virtuous Gallantry will change their state throughout the battle: "Chivalric Wrath": Summons "Speartip" statues and decreases all DMG taken by this unit. When 4 statues are on the field, this unit enters the Toughness Protection state. "Golden Harvest": Summons "Shield" statues and increases all DMG dealt by this unit. "Medal of Elegance": Summons "The Honored" statues. When statues exist on the field, this unit cannot be selected as a target. s during battle. He will alternate between "Chivalric Wrath" and "Golden Harvest" in Phase 1, and rotate between "Medal of Honor", "Golden Harvest", and "Chivalric Wrath" in that order during Phase 2. When switching stances, uses Soul Regained to destroy any remaining statues and reclaim "Soulfreed" from them. Chivalric Wrath : Takes 10% less DMG. Immediately uses Lance's Summon and Sweeping Lance . On subsequent turns, will reclaim Soulfreed from summoned statues if possible, before using Lance's Summon or Sweeping Lance . This stance lasts for 3 turns. If there are four "Speartip" statues on the field, Silver Knight of Virtuous Gallantry gains Toughness Protection. "Speartip" will either have or Weaknesses. Golden Harvest : Increases DMG dealt by 10% and SPD by 5% . Immediately uses Shield's Summon and Shield's Retribution , and spends subsequent turns attacking. This stance lasts for 3 turns. Each "The Shield" Taunts the chracter corresponding to its position (the rightmost "The Shield" Taunts the first character in the lineup, the one to its left Taunts the second character, and so forth), and gains a Weakness to the Taunted character's Type. if there are less than 4 characters in the lineup, any remaining "The Shield" will have a Weakness to the first character in the lineup. [ verification needed ] Medal of Honor : Immediately uses Honored Multitudes and Strength of Honor . Silver Knight of Virtuous Gallantry's next turn is delayed by 50%, during which he will use Undeniable Fate and switch stances. All "The Honored" will enter the "Soulfreed" state regardless of difficulty. After using Honors of the Red Queen , "The Honored" will destroy itself and grant Silver Knight of Virtuous Gallantry "Soulfreed". "The Honored" will either have or Weaknesses. Stellar Aegis (Stage 4): For every enemy on the field aside from Silver Knight of Virtuous Gallantry , all enemies deal 3% more DMG and receive 5% less DMG.

gameplayNotes: From Apocalyptic Shadow: Idol of the Locusts onwards, the Toughness of Sky-Shrouding Stardevourer Swarm is increased from 200 x3 to 240 x3 in Stage 4. Gnaw Stings summoned by this boss have Weaknesses. The Gnaw Sting summoned by Radiating Venom will immediately take action. Growth Hormones can stack up to 3 times. When a Gnaw Sting reaches 3 stacks of Growth Hormones, its attacks have a chance to inflict the Entanglement effect on the targets. When a Lesser Sting reaches 3 stacks of Growth Hormones, it will immediately take action. When a Gnaw Sting or Lesser Sting is defeated, deals 50 Toughness Reduction to Sky-Shrouding Stardevourer Swarm. This Toughness Reduction can ignore the Toughness Protection of Nesting Incubation . When a Lesser Sting is defeated, recovers 1 Skill Point . When Sky-Shrouding Stardevourer Swarm uses Nesting Incubation , its next action Ovum of Collapsed Star is delayed by 25%. Hormone Secretion (Stage 3+): Every 3rd summon spawns with 1 stack of Growth Hormone. The Insect Eggs granted by Nesting Incubation replace those typically granted by Infinite Propagation . Egg Burst (Stage 4): The Insect Eggs granted by Nesting Incubation are increased from 7 to 10 .

gameplayNotes: When Phase 1 starts: The Action of Blaze Out of Space is Advanced Forward by 25%. The Action of Soulhook Sovereign is Delayed by 50%. The Action of Ice Out of Space is Delayed by 25%. When Phase 2 starts: The Action of Dreamjolt Troupe's Beyond Overcooked is Advanced Forward by 100%. The Action of Memory Zone Meme "Shell of Faded Rage" is Advanced Forward by 25%. Soulcaller summons an Blaze Out of Space and Ice Out of Space in phase 1, and a Dreamjolt Troupe's Beyond Overcooked and Memory Zone Meme "Shell of Faded Rage" for phase 2. These enemies are nearly identical to their bug-type variants despite being normal elite enemies. When summoned, Soulhook Sovereign will transfer her weaknesses to them. When all summons are killed, their weaknesses transfer back to the boss. The enemy to her right (Blaze Out of Space and Beyond Overcooked) will always inherit Imaginary and Physical weakness, while the enemy to her left (Ice Out of Space and Shell of Faded Rage) will always inherit Fire and Wind weaknesses. Soulhook Sovereign does not make any Extra Action per turn. Blaze Out of Space and Ice Out of Space with Madden make one additional Extra Action per turn. Beyond Overcooked and Shell of Faded Rage do not make any Extra Action per turn. Soulhook Sovereign loses 25% of her Max Toughness when her summons are defeated. Stellar Aegis (Stage 3+): Each of the boss's summons on the field reduces the damage all enemies take by 75% each. Turn Back the Tide (Stage 4): During Phase 2, Puppet Understudy will enhance both of her summons rather than just one.

gameplayNotes: When Phase 1 starts: The Action of Disaster's Right Hand is Advanced Forward by 50%. The Action of Antimatter Engine is Advanced Forward by 40%. When Phase 2 starts: The Action of Antimatter Engine is Advanced Forward by 100%. The Action of Dawn's Left Hand is Advanced Forward by 50%. The boss' Toughness bar is fully depleted after the Antimatter Engine, Disaster's Right Hand and Dawn's Left Hand's health are broken. During phase 1, the Antimatter Engine makes one additional Extra Action per turn. In phase 2, it makes two Extra Actions per turn. Battle Hardened (Stage 3+): After using a single-target ability, enemy units gain 20% increased SPD for 1 turn. After using an AoE ATK ability, their ATK increases by 20% for 1 turn. [ verification needed ] Using a Support ability heals the target for 20% Max HP . Tenacious Resolve (Stage 4): All enemies receive 20% less DMG, but each Weakness Type they have increases DMG received by 5% .

gameplayNotes: Sam has Toughness Protection outside of Secondary Combustion. Sam takes 1 action each time outside of Secondary Combustion, and takes 2 consecutive actions each time while in Secondary Combustion . When characters consume Skill Points while Sam is Secondary Combustion , if the character's current HP is not sufficient, then the character's HP is reduced to 1. When characters consume Skill Points to attack while Sam is Secondary Combustion , the Additional DMG dealt by characters scales with the attack's original DMG, and does not take other Additional DMG or DoT Trigger into account.

gameplayNotes: When Propagation is used: 2 Juvenile Stings are summoned in Phase 1; 2 Juvenile Stings and 1 Lesser Sting are summoned in Phase 2/3; Swarm: True Sting (Complete) produces 1 spawn of itself in Phase 3. If there are already 4 other friendly units present, removes one to create the clone. Up to 2 spawns of Swarm: True Sting (Complete) can exist on the field. When Swarm Onslaught is used, if there are 1/2/3/4 other True Sting(s) on the field, 4/5/6/7 additional instances of Wind DMG equal to 100% ATK are dealt to a random target before the AoE Attack. Additionally, this ability restores 5 extra Energy for all characters. In Simulated Universe: Swarm Disaster , Swarm: True Sting (Complete) does not have the Ice weakness, and instead has 20% Ice RES.

gameplayNotes: Warp Trotters are listed alongside Treasures in map exploration progress. When a Trotter uses Run... Run! , its Toughness cannot be reduced, and it becomes immune to Crowd Control debuffs . If the Warp Trotter is startled and manages to escape, the player can cause it to respawn again by leaving the map and returning. Topaz and Numby 's Technique , Explicit Subsidy , will make the Warp Trotter tolerant of the player's presence until they change the active character. When a Warp Trotter is Taunted by the effects of Dr. Ratio 's Technique, Mold of Idolatry , it will stop moving until the duration of the Taunt expires.

gameplayNotes: Warp Trotters are listed alongside Treasures in map exploration progress. When a Trotter uses Run... Run! , its Toughness cannot be reduced, and it becomes immune to Crowd Control debuffs . If the Warp Trotter is startled and manages to escape, the player can cause it to respawn again by leaving the map and returning. Topaz and Numby 's Technique , Explicit Subsidy , will make the Warp Trotter tolerant of the player's presence until they change the active character. When a Warp Trotter is Taunted by the effects of Dr. Ratio 's Technique, Mold of Idolatry , it will stop moving until the duration of the Taunt expires.

gameplayNotes: When the battle starts: The Action of Banacademic Office's Charmony BananAdvisor is Advanced Forward by 60%. The Action of Banacademic Office's Assistanana (right) is Advanced Forward by 20%. The Action of Banacademic Office's Fortune BananAdvisor is Delayed by 10%. The Action of Banacademic Office's Assistanana (left) is Delayed by 50%. The Action of Banacademic Office's Dreamweaver BananAdvisor is Delayed by 80%. When this version of Banacademic Office's Charmony BananAdvisor uses Monkey No! Emergency Tutoring! , makes 2/3 (Phase 1/2) random friendly units and this unit switch to the "Classroom Channel" state and applies "Tutoring" to them instead. When Phase 2 starts, switches all "Off-Class Channel" states on all Banacademic Office members on the field to "Classroom Channel" states. "End-of-Semester Dinner" has the same base SPD as Wonder Forest's Banacademic Office Staff. When "End-of-Semester Dinner" is added on the Action Order for the first time, Advances Forward the Action of "End-of-Semester Dinner" by 25%.

Banacademic Office's Fortune BananAdvisor (Complete) starts at 1 in phase 1, increasing to 3 in phase 2, capping at 4 in phase 3.
